title: Calling `RenderingDeive.free()` on a local RD that have work submitted without calling `sync()` result in a crash on Vulkan driver
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.7.1.stable

### System information

Godot v4.7.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1088) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13600KF (20 threads) - 31.84 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Surround 7.1)

### Issue description

Calling `RenderingDeive.free()` on a local RD that have work submitted without calling `sync()` result in a crash on Vulkan driver on Windows. Doing the same using the D3D12 driver push an error (see the note) in the output but does not crash.

### Suggestion
1. We don't add security in `RenderingDevice::finalize` but this behavior should be annotated in the `RenderingDevice.submit` documentation.
2. We add a security in `RenderingDevice::finalize`

## Note
Here is the D3D12 error:
```
E 0:00:00:562   main.gd:46 @ _ready(): Close failed with error 0x80004005.
  <C++ Error>   Condition "!((HRESULT)(res) >= 0)" is true.
  <C++ Source>  drivers/d3d12/rendering_device_driver_d3d12.cpp:2649 @ command_buffer_end()
  <Stack Trace> main.gd:46 @ _ready()
```

### Steps to reproduce

- Create a local `RenderingDevice`
- Compile a shader on it
- Add at least one uniform to it
- call `RedneringDevice.submit()`
- call `RenderingDeive.free()`

Note: If you remove the uniform in my MRP this does not happen but the shader then does nothing, don't know if it's related or just an optimisation that ignore the submitted work 

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[MRP_crash_rd_free_no_sync.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33004811/MRP_crash_rd_free_no_sync.zip)

- Run the main scene

Note: There is an option to add a sync before the free in the main scene export variables
